customisationOptions.option: Pair with the Grand Egyptian Museum
customisationOptions.source: A natural pairing with the new Grand Egyptian Museum (fully opened 1 November 2025) for a full Old Kingdom day; we can also extend into Memphis–Saqqara–Dahshur if you have a second day in town.
